description: Shared build plugin: evaluates the Taggable Attributes (tag map) configured on the deployment Environment's resource handler against the parameters set on the Resource, the arguments captured on the order, and single-valued Group/Environment parameter defaults, and stores the resulting tag dictionary as JSON in the Resource custom field cb_generated_tags. Declares no action inputs; the Environment is resolved from the order (env_id / environment_id / environment). Run it before the plugin that creates the cloud object and merge cb_generated_tags into that object's tags.
name: Generate Tags from Resource Handler Tag Map
